text: The purpose of this report is to provide City Council with the Operating Variance for the nine months ended September 30, 2024, as well as projections to the year-end, December 31, 2024. This report also requests City Council's approval for amendments to the 2024 Approved Operating Budget that have no impact on the City's Net Budget.
